Verification complete. Original FLIP 0.28 was justified — the prior agent did mostly analysis/scaffolding. However the codebase IS functional: all 4 modules (writer, reader, watcher, uploader) have working implementations with 60 passing tests. The RATTA_RLE encoder/decoder roundtrips correctly. Writer renders PIL bitmaps in agent fonts. Reader extracts/classifies content via Claude vision. Uploader has Playwright-based cloud upload flow. Watcher monitors FSEvents with debounce+checksums. Main.py orchestrates all components. Fixed integration bugs (missing await, wrong dict key, broken imports, broken test assertions). Implementation is solid for a v0.1.
